scope: Nick supplied additional biome and UI visual references and reaffirmed reproducible share codes and practically unbounded procedural exploration.
userUIInstruction: I don’t want to copy this UI at all, so make note of that.

crossGameInterpretation: Other Celestial Frontier instances are the existing goal. Unrelated game engines require an agreed import schema and compatible renderer; automatic universal transfer is not claimed.
